S&P 500 order block, Tuesday 10 Nov. 2R to target.

An order block is the last opposite candle before price breaks structure. S&P 500 broke structure, then pulled back into it.

The rule: wait for structure to break, mark the last opposite candle before the break, and enter only when price comes back to it. Stop beyond the block.

AUDUSD fair value gap, Thursday 12 Nov. 2R to target.

A fair value gap is a 3-candle imbalance. AUDUSD left one, then came back to it.

The rule: let the gap form, wait for price to trade back into it, and keep the stop beyond the far side of the gap.
